bootstrap_rules.type: map(object({direction = string, protocol = string, port = number, remote_ipv4 = string}))
bootstrap_rules.description: Stable owned rule keys; exact endpoint and TCP/UDP port only. Keep existing rules during withdrawal; disabled interfaces contain exposure.

validation.condition: ${length(var.bootstrap_rules) <= 32 && alltrue([for key, r in var.bootstrap_rules : can(regex("^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,40}$", key)) && contains(["ingress", "egress"], r.direction) && contains(["tcp", "udp"], r.protocol) && r.port >= 1 && r.port <= 65535 && floor(r.port) == r.port && can(cidrnetmask("${r.remote_ipv4}/32"))])}
validation.error_message: At most 32 named exact IPv4 TCP/UDP service rules are supported.
